description: This Java source file defines a REST controller class ShoppingCategoryRESTController that provides web services for managing categories in an e-commerce application. It includes endpoints for retrieving, creating, and deleting categories, utilizing Spring MVC annotations and services, and handles requests related to categories for specific merchant stores.

classes.name: ShoppingCategoryRESTController
